# Draft:Star Wars: Galactic Racer

----
Star Wars: Galactic Racer is an upcoming racing video game set in the Star Wars universe. The game was announced in December 2025 during The Game Awards and is being developed by Fuse Games in collaboration with Lucasfilm Games. It is scheduled for release in 2026 for Microsoft Windows, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S.
Gameplay
Star Wars: Galactic Racer is described as a fast-paced action racing game focused on high-speed competition across multiple planets in the Star Wars galaxy. Players compete in the so-called Galactic League, an underground racing circuit that emerges in the aftermath of the fall of the Galactic Empire.
The game features a variety of racing vehicles, including speeders and repulsorcraft, each with distinct handling characteristics. Players can upgrade and customize their vehicles throughout the game. The single-player campaign follows a racer known as Shade, who competes across the galaxy while navigating rivalries within the league.
Development
Star Wars: Galactic Racer is being developed by Fuse Games, a studio founded in 2023 by developers with previous experience on racing franchises such as Need for Speed and Burnout. The game represents Fuse Games' debut title and its first collaboration with Lucasfilm Games.
The announcement of the game was accompanied by a reveal trailer showcasing racing sequences on planets including Jakku and highlighting environmental hazards inspired by iconic Star Wars locations.
Announcement
The game was officially revealed during The Game Awards 2025. According to fan and news site SWTORStrategies, the announcement emphasized a return to pure racing gameplay within the Star Wars franchise, distinguishing the title from previous combat-focused space games.
Release
Star Wars: Galactic Racer is scheduled for release in 2026. While a specific release date has not yet been announced, the game is listed on digital storefronts such as Steam, allowing players to add it to their wishlists ahead of launch.
Reception
As the game has not yet been released, critical reception is currently limited to reactions to its announcement. Early coverage from gaming media highlighted the return of racing-focused gameplay within the Star Wars universe and the pedigree of the development team.
